name: KitchenFoodSafetyLog
tagline: HACCP temperature logs, critical limits, corrective actions and daily sign-off – a complete kitchen food safety app for Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A full HACCP food safety module in one PCF control: today dashboard with compliance and attention list, due-checks round with quick entry and overdue alerts, log with bulk verification, trends per check point against the critical limit band, and a daily sign-off with check coverage. Rules cover critical limits per check type, a cooling time limit, probe calibration, mandatory corrective actions with re-checks and independent verification.
features: Critical limits per check type from a simple text list (Fridge=0..5;Cooking=75..)
Pass / Warning / Fail with a configurable warning margin
Check schedule (Point:Type:Area:EveryHours) with due, due-soon and overdue states inside kitchen hours
Quick entry on the round – type the reading and press Enter
Cooling time rule (e.g. 90 min) and cooling start time
Probe calibration: failed probe checks flag later readings and block new ones
Corrective action pick-lists per type, re-check must pass before verification
Independent verification and day sign-off with check coverage and comment
Trend chart with limit band per check point, 24 h / 3 days / 7 days
Void with reason (audit trail), undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, phone layout
